verdict.rationale: No evidence states GrowthBook's policy on AI model training, and no opt-out is documented. Its privacy architecture does limit what the vendor ever holds. It can be fully self-hosted on your own infrastructure. Targeting attribute values such as user IDs and emails are never sent to GrowthBook. It runs warehouse-native, so experiment data stays in your own warehouse. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or AI data-use policy, a documented opt-out control for the cloud SaaS, and independent corroboration.
